verdict.rationale: Sentry applies to this axis, but the pack shows only indirect support. The web API is documented as able to "manage and export data", and the self-hosted option lets you run all of Sentry on your own server, which puts data custody in the user's hands. Neither item mentions retention periods or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, explicit event/issue/project data deletion controls (UI or API), GDPR/data-subject deletion workflows, and independent corroboration that these controls work.
